name: TI DSP audio processor (room correction & tube amp emulation)

mentions.name: TI DSP audio processor (room correction & tube amp emulation)
mentions.description: This hardware project uses a Texas Instruments dev board with C7x and C66 DSP cores to run audio signal processing: parametric EQ (PEQ) and FIR-based room correction plus tube amplifier emulation, with a virtual bass array planned as the next feature.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Bought a TI dev board with c7x and c66 dsp cores. Have it doing PEQ and FIR room correction, along with tube amplifier emulation.

Will be trying to implement a virtual bass array next.
